outcome: Spirometry lung function at age 11-12 years
cohort: Two cohorts of Australian children: HealthNuts (n=5276, born 2006-2010) and the Longitudinal Study of Australian Children (LSAC, n=5107, born 2003-2004)
finding: There was a small, possible association between caesarean delivery and asthma at age 6-7 years in one cohort (HealthNuts) but not the other (LSAC), and no clear associations with eczema or spirometric lung function at age 11-12 years were observed.
